notes.title: Go To Hell on 24Indie!
notes.content:
We’re excited to share that Go To Hell has been featured on [url=https://24indie.com]24indie.com[/url] ! 🎮🔥

In their latest review, the team dives into our fast-paced, demon-slaying chaos — exploring the gameplay, mechanics, hellish humor, and everything that makes Go To Hell a blast to play.

📖 Read the full article here:
👉 [url=https://24indie.com/go-to-hell-a-devilishly-good-time/]https://24indie.com/go-to-hell-a-devilishly-good-time/[/url]
Big thanks to 24indie for the coverage, and to you all for joining us in the depths. Stay sharp, stay alive, and keep blasting!
